records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total Revenue: Total revenue for the first quarter of 2022 decreased 7% as compared to the fourth quarter of 2021 primarily due to decreases in both DRAM and NAND sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, we have experienced volatility in the markets that our products are sold into, driven by the move to a stay-at-home economy and fluctuations in consumer and business spending, which has affected demand for certain of our products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In some cases, we have added alternative suppliers, executed long-term supply agreements, and increased our on-hand inventory of raw materials needed in our operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales of DRAM products for the first quarter of 2022 decreased 8% as compared to the fourth quarter of 2021 primarily due to a mid-single-digit percent decrease in bit shipments and a low-single-digit percent decline in average selling prices.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •CNBU operating income decreased primarily due to lower average selling prices and decreases in bit shipments, partially offset by manufacturing cost reductions.
